purpose: Dated accepted-release pins and external promotion authority; a source checkout does not certify deployment

currentRuntime.identityRule: Read authenticated runtime health and deployed frontend identity; match source head/tree, build/archive, contract and snapshot to the immutable release evidence packet.
currentRuntime.acceptanceRule: Use the dated clean-browser/API/MCP/model/map/lead/access and privacy receipts for that exact runtime identity. A successful health response alone is not full acceptance.
currentRuntime.sourceCheckoutRule: Final source commits and runtime acceptance are bound by a source-independent external receipt supplied with the final access package. Never guess a final head/build or rewrite source to contain its own identity.
currentRuntime.retentionRule: Use the dated approved PR/access receipt and earliest actually configured dependency expiry. A planning target or native map-key expiry alone does not establish complete runtime retention.

dataProfile.meaning: Historical immutable public/runtime data identities are retained. New official parcel observation sidecar and actual admission use their own manifest/receipt. Legacy private/protected mode names are not source-rights classifications.
dataProfile.freeSourceClosure: Completed finite lawful free-source permit route; no qualified current-active/long-open cohort established. New official parcel observations are a separately evidenced retained-row addition, not a permit refresh. No paid source is required, purchased or needed for reproduction. Unsearched paid full history remains unknown.

strictAgeExample.meaning: Historical accepted strict positive. Compare the final current-runtime rehearsal receipt; do not convert unknown-age matches into strict age positives.

publicationBoundary: Historical CID1/CID2 public identity; current retained run04 and bounded CLI/Atlas outputs local-only. New public/Atlas/IPNS/on-chain/registry effects require separate authorization and verified receipts.
submissionBoundary: Local corrected media/PR preparation only. Exact live Human phrase APPROVE P11 V1.1 VIDEO AND DRAFT PR EFFECTS precedes upload/non-force push/draft PR creation. Slowking waits for actual playable approved media, both PRs, PR-contained runtime/access and green CI. No Ready transition or employer message is implied.

usageLimits.remainingRule: Use dated durable-ledger readback from the final receipt, not static source values.

historicalP7AcceptedRelease.meaning: Accepted scoped runtime/access baseline, not a claim that every original positive-source outcome is met or a later documentation commit is already deployed.

historicalAssemblyAuthority.finalPromotionRule: The external final release receipt, not a predicted source field here, binds final head/tree, archive, frontend, contract, snapshots, deployment time, first-use checks, retention and access headroom.

acceptedTechnicalBaseline.meaning: Accepted technical history only. Its masked media/data-boundary interpretation is superseded. No later source, observation admission, deployment or media is certified by this record.

sourceContractAuthority: Read the producer/consumer packages/contracts/contract_manifest.json and match the final external release receipt; do not infer current deployment from this documentation.

evaluatorAccess.mode: Existing low-privilege application capability in the approved draft PR access section
evaluatorAccess.currentQuotaRetentionAndCode: Read the approved PR and dated external access receipt; no static source field extends them.

historicalRecordedAvailability.retentionRule: At least fourteen days after final release or employer acknowledgment, whichever is later; actual retained-through date and finite dependency renewals are recorded in the external final access receipt.
historicalRecordedAvailability.qualification: The accepted map expiry is not an automatic fourteen-day extension for a subsequent release.
historicalRecordedAvailability.meaning: Historical recorded values and old planning rule only; not current configured expiry or a new retention guarantee.

historicalAccountObservation.meaning: Dated read-only observation, not a final invoice or permanent availability
